definitions.explanation: Visiting and inspecting a property (apartment, house, office) in person before deciding to rent or buy it.
A viewing or preview of an exhibition, event, or product before it opens to the general public.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}にマンションの{内覧|ないらん}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to view an apartment this weekend.

examples.japanese: {内覧|ないらん}のときに{日当|ひあ}たりを{確認|かくにん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should check the sunlight exposure when you view the property.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{内覧|ないらん}の{予約|よやく}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I made an appointment with the real estate agency for a property viewing.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}の{内覧|ないらん}{会|かい}に{招待|しょうたい}された。
examples.english: I was invited to the museum's preview event.

examples.japanese: {一般|いっぱん}{公開|こうかい}{前|まえ}の{内覧|ないらん}{会|かい}には{関係者|かんけいしゃ}のみ{参加|さんか}できる。
examples.english: Only involved parties can attend the preview event before the public opening.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいショッピングモールの{内覧|ないらん}{会|かい}が{開催|かいさい}された。
examples.english: A preview event for the new shopping mall was held.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common everyday use of {内覧|ないらん} is for viewing apartments or houses when looking for a place to live. The preview/exhibition sense is more formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内覧|ないらん}する (to view a property)
- {内覧|ないらん}{会|かい} (preview event, open house)
- {内覧|ないらん}{予約|よやく} (viewing appointment)
- {内覧|ないらん}{可能|かのう} (available for viewing — seen on property listings)

TIPS FOR PROPERTY VIEWINGS IN JAPAN:
When doing an {内覧|ないらん}, it is common to check {日当|ひあ}たり (sunlight), {収納|しゅうのう} (storage), {周辺|しゅうへん}{環境|かんきょう} (surrounding area), and {騒音|そうおん} (noise levels).
